verdict: Meta leads flowing efficiently; two tracking gaps are being resolved now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 22 leads from Meta at $11.68 per lead — a strong, stable baseline with no sign of cost creep through the active window. Google Business Profile generated 194 engagement actions this period, though calls dropped to zero across all three listings in the final three days (Oct 27–29), down from an average of 11 actions per day prior; listing optimization is being actioned to close that gap. Separately, a CRM authentication issue has temporarily blinded the pipeline view, so lead intake inside the CRM cannot be verified this week — the 22 confirmed leads are real, but follow-through tracking is paused until the fix is in place. Lead volume showed mild softening late in the week while daily spend held steady, so cost per lead will be watched closely going into next period.
